select cls,
  cast(floor(fish_date_doy/10)*10 as int) as doy_bucket,
  sum(yt)/sum(anglers) as share_per_angler,
  count(*) as boat_days
from trips
where fish_date_season=2 and cls in ('day_1_5','overnight','three_quarter') and fish_date_doy>=290
group by 1,2
order by 2,1

select index_id, avail_doy, value from climate
where avail_season=2 and index_id='oni'
order by avail_doy
